query: UPDATE meta_messaging_send SET native_retry_at=now()+interval '30 seconds' WHERE id=$1 AND connection_id=$2 AND channel_id=$3 AND provider_message_id=$4 AND state IN ('accepted','sent','delivered','read','failed') AND (message_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meta_messaging_message m WHERE m.message_id=meta_messaging_send.message_id AND m.media_state='pending'))
